verdict.rationale: React's docs describe components as pieces of UI with their own logic and appearance that receive data and return what should appear on screen. They write that markup in JSX, a JavaScript syntax extension, so markup and rendering logic live together in a language developers already know. TypeScript support is also documented. Missing for 10: any evidence of how styles are written within components, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the colocated markup-plus-logic authoring experience.
